body:
## Pull request overview

Implements two new enterprise metadata-platform visual designers in `@object-ui/plugin-designer` (Object Manager + Field Designer), along with the supporting `@object-ui/types` schemas, i18n keys across all locales, and test infra updates so the plugin-designer test suite runs reliably.

**Changes:**
- Added `ObjectManager` and `FieldDesigner` components and registered them in the designer ComponentRegistry.
- Extended `@object-ui/types` with Object/Field designer types + schemas.
- Added i18n keys (all 10 locales) + plugin-designer fallback translations; updated plugin-designer test setup and Vite aliasing.

### Reviewed changes

The "Unreleased" section now contains two consecutive "### Fixed" headings (one added for the plugin-designer test infra fix, followed immediately by an existing "### Fixed"). Please merge these into a single "### Fixed" section to avoid duplicated headings and keep the changelog structure consistent.
```suggestion

```

Field reordering (the move up/down controls calling `moveField`) is newly introduced behavior but isn’t covered by the FieldDesigner test suite. Adding tests that verify the order changes correctly within a group (and that `sortOrder`/group boundaries are respected) would help prevent regressions once the move logic is adjusted.
